raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and related parts under the EAR. Exporters of civilian firearms (HS 9302/9303) to the US market should re-verify ECCN classification, license exception eligibility, and end-use/end-user controls, while aligning US HTS lines, Section 301 tariff exposure, and Entity List screening. Note that rescission restores prior rules but does not eliminate ITAR overlap, restricted-party screening, or state/federal firearms import requirements on the US side.
raw.content_zh: 美国BIS撤销拜登时期的民用枪械出口规则，放宽民用枪械、弹药及相关零部件在EAR下的许可与分类处理。对美出口民用枪械（HS 9302/9303）的企业应重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外适用性及最终用途/最终用户管控，同时对齐美国HTS编码、301关税风险及实体清单筛查。需注意：撤销规则恢复原有制度，但并不免除ITAR交叉适用、受限方筛查及美国州/联邦层面的枪械进口要求。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts under the restored EAR categories; confirm whether items fall under 0A/0B controls or move to EAR99, and document the basis for the classification.
Screen each item against USML Categories I-III to confirm it is not ITAR-controlled; obtain DDTC jurisdiction determination where ambiguity exists before claiming EAR treatment.
Assess eligibility for restored license exceptions (e.g., for civilian end users) and retain end-use/end-user statements and non-military end-use certifications.
Map 10-digit HTS lines for firearms and parts, check Section 301 additional duty exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up.
Run BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied-party screening on all US consignees, brokers, and end users; retain screening records for audit.
Confirm ATF import permits, state-level firearms regulations, and any applicable environmental/lead ammunition restrictions before shipment.
